title: Server-Sent Events (SSE), Event Streams & Real-Time Broadcasting
description: The ferrox-sse crate provides real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming for Rust web applications. It features Tokio broadcast channels, client connection heartbeats, event ID reconnect resumes, and low-latency HTTP/2 event streaming.
